title: Fine-grain charge matrix & export UX for token attribution and pricing presets
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a fine-grain 'charge matrix' panel and CSV/NDJSON export flow for the Redwood Console that lets users explore token-level charge attribution across multiple dimensions (route, model variant, prompt slice, user segment) and capture pricing presets that map to charge rollups. Focus on rapid filtering, deterministic rollups for chargeback, and compact export schemas for downstream billing pipelines.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive charge matrix mock where rows are time buckets and columns are attribution facets (model, route, prompt-tag) with cell drill-down to per-message token lines
Export flow that produces both per-token and aggregated CSV/NDJSON schemas; user can choose aggregation keys and a pricing preset to apply during export
Pricing preset composer available in-panel to simulate per-token rates, per-message surcharges, and tiered volume discounts; presets persist to account-level settings
Design passes accessibility contrast checks and supports keyboard-only navigation for cell focus and drilldown
PM and Eng have approved the schema for downstream consumers (billing, chargeback, analytics)

design_notes: Charge matrix rows are adaptive time-buckets (auto: 5m/1h/1d) with ability to pin fixed window
Cells show two-layer data: primary = total charge (currency), secondary = token count (muted). Hover expands to example message lines with token breakdown.
Filtering supports multi-select across facets; filters are additive and reflected in export schema as 'filters_applied' metadata
Pricing presets include: base-per-token, model-factor multiplier, prompt-surcharge, tiered-discounts. Presets preview updates cell-level numbers without changing raw telemetry.
Default export formats: per_token.ndjson (one line per token event), per_message.csv (aggregated by message), and rollup.csv (user-specified keys). Include schema header and 'applied_preset' metadata
acceptance_test_steps: Open console > Cost Explorer > Charge Matrix. Default view renders for last 7 days with hourly buckets.
Apply filters: select model 'rw-v2-quant', route '/chat', and tag 'support-bot'. Matrix updates and cell tooltips show sample messages.
Open pricing preset composer, create 'POC-preset' with base 0.000002 USD/token and 10% model multiplier. Apply and observe preview refresh.
Start export, choose 'per_message.csv' with aggregation keys ['owner','environment'], verify file includes 'applied_preset' block in metadata header and rows match previewed numbers.
Keyboard-only: navigate to a cell, press Enter to open drilldown, tab through export controls and complete export using only keyboard
ui_variants: Comparison: side-by-side two presets with delta column
notes_for_engineering: API contract: token-level lines include timestamp, model, route, prompt_tag, token_count, token_type, raw_token_cost (microcents)
Export should optionally apply pricing preset transformation server-side to avoid client precision issues
Telemetry: emit matrix.view, matrix.filter.change, export.complete with summary payload
